failure_mode: A part stops answering, and the system does not start it again.
cause: The part does not answer and its process does not stop, as in a loop with no end.
effect: The system that the part holds stops. When it is Self-Observation, the signal stops (DEC-182). Each other system waits until a person starts it again.
detection: Self-Observation finds that the system does not answer (REQ-SO-001).

failure_mode: A part that stops at each start never runs.
cause: A fault in the part, or data that the part cannot read after an update.
effect: The system that the part holds does not run until a person or a new version answers it.
detection: The system reports each part that it starts again (REQ-HO-011).

failure_mode: A part other than those of External Access reaches a destination outside the host.
cause: A part is added, or changed in a new version, without its fence, and a runtime gives a part a route to outside by default.
effect: The part reaches a service with no record of the call and past the limit of the month (RSK-PL-008).
detection: The system finds it at an interval and reports it (REQ-HO-017).

failure_mode: The platform cannot start, make its copy or start on a new version, because its storage is full.
cause: The data grows (DEC-021) and fills the storage that the host gives the platform.
effect: The platform does not run, or the copy away from the host stops and REQ-PL-022 fails at the loss of the host.
detection: Self-Observation raises work when the storage that a part uses passes its threshold (REQ-HO-012, REQ-SO-021).

failure_mode: Data that a source sends is not held, because the storage of the platform is full.
cause: The data grows (DEC-021), and nobody gives the platform more storage.
effect: Acquisition, work and exchanges stop where they write, until a person gives the platform more storage.
detection: Self-Observation raises work when the storage that a part uses passes its threshold (REQ-HO-012, REQ-SO-021).

failure_mode: The system adds a fact at each start of a part in a loop, with no bound.
cause: A part stops at each start, and the system starts it again at once.
effect: The facts fill the storage of Self-Observation (DEC-179, DEC-169), and Hosting then refuses its writes (REQ-HO-010).
detection: Self-Observation raises work when the storage that a part uses passes its threshold (REQ-HO-012, REQ-SO-021).
